title: Opening Rules of the Paired Binder
summary: Opens the school's paired ties to a Warrior with duet knots and matched guards and the founding closing of two foes into one pair.

title: Hawk-Eye Manual of the Basin Binder
summary: Teaches cords cast from a high perch with a hawk's eye and a snare shaped like a basin ending in the school's stoop.

title: Book of the Court of Twin Knots
summary: Shows a Xiantian student how to hold a whole gathering in paired knots that each pull on a neighbour.

title: Treatise of the Core Tether and the Azure Horizon
summary: Draws tethers from the formed core to hold a foe at the limit of sight and ties the foe's qi to the line.

title: First Oath-Book of the Wind Binder
summary: Gives a Warrior the first oath of the wind binder with sworn cords and gust hitches and a closing storm of vows.

title: Manual of the Bearing Held Through Gusts
summary: Trains the binder to keep one bearing against pushing gusts and to tie a foe to the bearing the binder holds.

title: Canon of the Open Oath
summary: A Xiantian canon of the binding that takes no wall and no shelter and rests on an oath spoken in the open.

title: Book of the Oathcore and the Long Wind
summary: Joins the sworn oath to the formed core and sends tethers a long way on the wind ending in an unbroken oath.
